description: Call an API that charges per request in NGT on Base (x402). Handles the 402 itself: pays the seller's price only if it is NGT on Base and at or under the cap, then returns the response (JSON, or text cut to the first 50,000 characters) with the amount paid, the seller wallet and the Base transaction. Use when the user asks for data or an action from an NGT-paywalled URL. Headers the user configured for the URL's host (NGT_HOST_HEADERS) are added for you; you cannot set or see them. Each call spends real NGT; do not call in a loop. On failure, follow the next step in the error.

max_price_ngt.description: Most to pay for this call, in NGT. Cannot exceed the server cap of 0.01 NGT.

max_price_usdc.description: Ignored: the user has not turned USDC on, so this server pays only NGT.
